statusText: The US cash session closed at 20:00Z and both instruments settled off their highs for the first time all day. NDX finished 30,482.35 (+2.83%), 75 points under the 30,557.33 high; NQ is 30,775.25, 87 under its own. VIX ended flat at 14.82 and the 10-year eased to 4.963%. The six-hour extreme-holding structure has ended, and Tail steps down from 33 to 23. Mapped policy state: WATCH.
recommendation: Mapped policy state WATCH applies jointly to NQ_FUTURES and NAS100_CFD now that Tail has returned to the watch band. The danger window is kept narrow at 13:30-15:00Z on 22 September, covering Tuesday's cash open and first full cash hour, which is where the forecast places the conditional peak. Tail is well below the strong-block threshold, and existing-position management and protective handling are unaffected by the mapping.
headline: Nasdaq-100 closes a record-setting session off its high, ending the day's extreme-holding structure
body:
The cash session settled at 20:00Z. The NDX closed at 30,482.35, up 838.18 (+2.83%), against a 29,933.22-30,557.33 day range, an open of 29,947.16 and Friday's 29,644.17 close. The session high was set during the power hour and the index finished roughly 75 points beneath it. NQ futures are 30,775.25 (+2.87%) on a 29,904.00-30,862.75 range, about 87 points under their own high, and ES is 7,828.00 against a 7,847.25 high. The PHLX Semiconductor Index closed 12,433.17 (+4.29%) having reached 12,491.61. For six consecutive cash hours the day low had remained the opening print and both instruments had held within a handful of points of their extremes; that condition no longer holds on any of the four instruments, and the give-back was orderly rather than a reversal.

The cross-asset picture never confirmed stress and has now decayed. VIX finished at 14.82 on a 14.60-15.13 range, up 0.01 on the day, so a +2.83% index move produced no volatility premium at all. The 10-year eased to 4.963% from a 4.998% previous close inside a 4.951-4.976 range, and the 2-year was 4.76%, up less than a basis point. WTI fell roughly 5% toward $95 and Brent to near $101, an eleven-day low, after President Trump indicated openness to meeting Iran's president at this week's UN General Assembly and Saudi exports through the Strait of Hormuz recovered to about 2.9 million barrels per day from 700,000 in August. That is a risk-premium unwind working in the same direction as equities rather than a stress signal.

The drivers of the move were verified and specific: AMD rose about 10% to a record and briefly crossed a one trillion dollar market capitalisation, Intel and Arm each gained roughly 10% as Meta's MUSE agent was read as raising server-CPU demand, and the Nasdaq Composite posted a record close at 27,122.09. A White House state dinner for President Xi on Thursday, with a large roster of AI chief executives attending and the November tariff truce on the agenda, is the forward catalyst sustaining the AI bid.

For this risk measure the decisive change is mechanical. The 20:00Z auction has cleared, which removes the cash-session continuation mechanism that produced Monday's directional efficiency, and the final prints delivered the session's first genuine give-back from the extremes. Under the inherited calibration, orderly price discovery with retracement and decaying volatility is grounds for Tail to fall rather than persist, so the reading moves from 33 to 23 and out of the elevated band. It is not returned to the overnight baseline, because the trend regime is only one session old, the day produced no meaningful retracement until the very end, and the Iran file remains a live two-sided headline channel overnight. Tuesday's 13:30Z cash open is the evidence that would confirm or invalidate the rest of the horizon.

lookbackSummary: The prior 24 hours contain a complete regime cycle. Through Sunday evening and the Asian session, eleven consecutive hourly assessments read mode normal with Tail between 5 and 9 and Stress in the low thirties. From 06:00Z the mode turned trend-up on the crude retreat and the verified server-CPU repricing, and Tail ratcheted from 5 to 22 across eight readings, crossing into the watch band at 11:00Z. The 14:00Z assessment recorded the first elevated-band reading at the cash open at Tail 26, and 15:00Z through 19:00Z read 28, 30, 30, 32 and 33 as the day low stayed at the opening print. Sixteen of the 24 hours carried a mapped EA_ON state, three WATCH and five BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. No hour reached the strong-block threshold, and Stress rose in step from 32 to 57 without leaving the elevated band. Confidence improved monotonically from 71 to 90 as live evidence accumulated across the session.
outlookSummary: The horizon opens at the watch band in the settlement hour, holds there for the first post-close hour while continuation would have to carry on futures alone, then returns to the low band from 22:00Z as the maintenance break and the Asian handover reset directional flow. The overnight path settles to the quiet range baseline the lookback shows is typical outside US hours, reaching a floor of 9 between 02:00Z and 04:00Z, then builds slowly with European liquidity from 06:00Z. The 13:30Z US cash open on 22 September is the horizon's decisive structural checkpoint at conditional Tail 18, and the conditional peak is 23 in the 15:00Z hour, the window in which Monday's bid proved it would not retrace. Richmond Fed manufacturing, Williams and Jefferson cluster at 14:00-14:20Z, and the 2-year auction and Barkin speech fall together at 17:00Z. The horizon contains no reading at or above the block threshold. Every hour beyond the current one is conditional risk, and Tuesday's opening structure is the evidence that would confirm or invalidate it.
